newsitem.title: UK: Pearson no comment on Putnam Berkley.
newsitem.headline: Pearson no comment on Putnam Berkley.

text.p: British media group Pearson declined comment on Wednesday on reports that it was negotiating to buy U.S. book publisher Putnam Berkley.
"We don't get involved in talking about who we are or aren't in talks with," a Pearson spokeswoman said.
Sources in the U.S. familiar with the talks, told Reuters this week that the price was in the mid $300 million range but details and timing of the sale remained to be ironed out.
Putnam Berkley Publishing Group is the book publishing arm of MCA Inc, Seagram Co Ltd's entertainment unit.
Putnam Berkley is expected to be incorporated in Pearson's Penguin publishing imprint if the sale goes ahead.
Penguin can boast a number of top-selling authors but is heavily dependent on its backlist. Putnam Berkley has several titles on the latest best-seller lists in the United States.
